title: Follow-up after emergency oral Schedule II dispensing
rule_summary: The prescriber must deliver the required written or electronic follow-up Schedule II prescription to the pharmacy within seven days after authorizing emergency oral dispensing.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply emergency follow-up requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Follow-up after emergency oral Schedule II dispensing

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing emergency follow-up with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
